title: The personality of centenarians – B2 English Listening Test

seo.title: The personality of centenarians – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: English advanced listening test (CEFR B2). Transcription included. Watch a video about the personality and answer the questions.

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Watch a video about a study on the relationship between personality and longevity. For questions 1 to 6 choose the correct option. You can see the transcription after submitting your answers.

See the full list of B2 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: Centenarians are inclined to talk about their feelings.
In order to carry out their study, they tried to find centenarians who had a positive personality.
They found that a positive attitude towards life is the secret of longevity.
They wanted to study whether positive personality was in the genes of those who live longest.
They found that the positive personality traits common in older people are associated with age more than with genes.
The conclusion of the study is that ______

choices.html: if you have a positive attitude you will probably live longer.
positive old people have always had a positive personality.
when you get very old your personality changes.
